description: Find FRC teams and events by name when you do not know their keys (e.g., 'Cheesy Poofs' for frc254, 'Silicon Valley' for 2025casj). Searches TBA's index of every team (key, nickname) and event (key, name) with a case-insensitive substring match and returns at most 25 teams and 25 events, exact matches first, plus the total number of matches. The full index is about 700 KB, so this tool always filters it; refine the query when the totals exceed 25.

query.description: Case-insensitive text to look for in team keys, team numbers, team nicknames, event keys, and event names (e.g., 'Cheesy', '254', 'Silicon Valley', '2025casj'). At least 2 characters.

name: get_search_index
title: Search Teams and Events
